2610.06563.title: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
2610.06563.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of acting in complex tool-use environments, yet they often fail to recognize when tasks are infeasible and no valid solution exists. Recent work has formalized this reliability gap as the problem of agentic abstention, and existing approaches typically optimize a model or agent harness against a fixed set of tasks, leading to limited generalization to unseen failure modes. We introduce HERA, a framework for harness-environment co-evolution for agentic abstention. HERA consists of (i) a pipeline to automatically construct verifiable pairs of feasible and infeasible tasks by applying controlled environment mutations that transform solvable tasks into cases requiring abstention, and (ii) a co-evolution procedure in which performance failures on previous tasks are used to drive harness adaptation and generate new execution environments and tasks geared towards previous weaknesses. On held-out evaluation tasks, an evolved harness from HERA improves abstention accuracy from 61.7% to 83.3% while improving feasible-task completion from 68.3% to 76.7%, achieving the highest abstention and feasible-task completion among the compared methods. The resulting best harness transfers across 19 other LLMs, improving abstention accuracy by 15.3 percentage points on average without any model-specific optimization, and enabling smaller models to match the performance of more powerful models at an estimated 85% lower cost.
2610.06563.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在複雜的工具使用環境中越來越能夠行動，但它們經常無法識別任務是否不可行，且不存在有效解決方案。最近的研究將這一可靠性差距形式化為代理性不作為的問題，現有的方法通常針對固定的任務集來優化模型或代理，導致對未見失敗模式的有限泛化。我們介紹了HERA，一個針對代理性不作為的工具-環境共同演化框架。HERA包含（i）一個管道，通過應用控制環境變異自動構建可驗證的可行和不可行任務對，將可解決的任務轉化為需要不作為的情況，以及（ii）一個共同演化過程，其中對先前任務的性能失敗用於驅動工具的適應並生成針對先前弱點的新執行環境和任務。在保留的評估任務上，來自HERA的演化工具將不作為的準確率從61.7%提高到83.3%，同時將可行任務的完成率從68.3%提高到76.7%，在比較的方法中達到了最高的不作為和可行任務完成率。最終的最佳工具在19個其他LLM上進行轉移，平均提高了15.3個百分點的不作為準確率，且沒有任何特定於模型的優化，使得較小的模型能夠以估計85%的較低成本達到更強大模型的性能。
